items.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009
items.q: We played a concert for the JVC Jazz Festival together and rode around taxis in New York a little bit and went to music stores.

ctx.x: I met Kenny in New Orleans. He came and visited New Orleans in the mid-nineties to play a little private jazz party of sorts with some other friends of ours: Dan Barrett and I think Snooky Young was on that gig. I think, oh I’m trying to remember who the other musicians were. I’m not going to remember off the top of my head. Damn I can’t remember who else was in the band. Oh, Ralph Sutton was the piano player, because he came with us too. And Kenny had a longtime friend, Frank Laidlaw, who was living in New…

the cemeteries, and we went by Larry Shields’ house in the Garden District uptown somewhere, and we just rode around. I think we probably ate lunch, I don’t remember where though. And I went to the concert that night, and that was about ’95, so I was about 25 years old. And I knew who he was a little bit with his work with some of the Soprano Summit things. But I wasn’t really involved and I wasn’t really doing any types of jazz type parties or anything like that. None of that scene was really on my radar. I knew…
